title: We can focus on discovering phenomena instead of solving problems
snippet: Remember the Mandelbrot set? The Mandelbrot set is the set of complex numbers c such that if we start at x_1 = 0 and we inductively define x_{n + 1} = x_n^2 + c, the absolute value of x_n doesn't go to infinity. It's a simple definition, but when you plot it, you get mind-blowing fractal images like the ones in the animation above. What an amazing phenomenon!
